landmarks.notes: The GLB is in public/landmarks and is not rebuilt. It is not substituted for a footprint. Its plan is 42.8 m by 20.2 m. 1 Church Street (this recorded position) is a 34 m by 34 m, 38.1 m office east of MD 355, outside Town Square. 130 Gibbs Street, the six-storey plaza front, is 23.3 m by 43.4 m and irregular; the same rectangle overhangs that polygon by up to 3.6 m. Either swap would delete approved mass or cover the plaza. hideProcedural stays false so the county masses remain. The plaza clock is a module on footprint 227490.

The GLB is in public/landmarks and is not rebuilt. Its plan is 31.5 m by 30.5 m. The candidate footprint 129621 is 43.0 m by 27.1 m and 28.83 m tall, a 2015 apartment slab, so the rectangle would leave a gap in that block. hideProcedural stays false and the model is not placed on top of the mass.
